DON’T REALLY FULLPORT LOL, but if I had to pick one theme with the best risk/reward right now, it would be memory.

AI demand is exploding, but memory supply cannot catch up fast enough. New fabs take years to build, HBM uses way more production capacity than normal memory, and the biggest manufacturers are starting to get pricing power again.

The crazy part is valuation.

Memory is projected to be one of the fastest-growing parts of semiconductors, but names like Micron, Samsung, SK Hynix, SanDisk, and Kioxia are still trading around 5 to 8x 2027 earnings while a lot of AI semis trade closer to 20 to 30x forward earnings.

Fastest growth in semis.

Some of the lowest valuations.

Tight supply.

Pricing power.

I already posted my full memory thesis and my 3 favorite trades in Discord.
